title: I agree with the BUG-MAE-003 won't-fix. A 7-day cost with no per-item date in a verbatim fixture would be made up, and the README already says OpenRouter's 30-day activity stays on its card

Reversal method: restoring each file to its HEAD version would not compile, because the tests call new APIs (showsNoRecentUsage, DurationParts, staleDetail, topUpConfigSections, loadingSince). So for each fix I reverted only the fixing lines in the working tree, with a backup of Sources/ in scratchpad/review-B14-app-followups. The filtered suites passed with the fix (8 suites, 63 tests). With the fix reverted: 11 issues in 7 suites, plus the Int(Double) crash for BUG-MAE-006. After copying the backup back, `diff -r` against the backup was clean, the git diff was byte-identical to the one I captured before starting, and it matches reviews/diffs/B14-app-followups.diff except for the audit-pack files FINDINGS.json and run-meta.json.

BUG-MAE-003 won't-fix: I agree. With no per-item date on the wire, any Day or Week value for OpenRouter would be made up. Leaving it out is correct under the rule that a snapshot never contributes money to Analytics (AnalyticsStore.swift:167).
